I am a postdoctoral researcher at CREST, working with
Arnak Dalalyan on the mathematics of generative models: diffusion models, flow matching,
and what Gaussian smoothing does near the support of the data. Before that, I did a PhD
in statistics on Langevin sampling algorithms, then spent six years building deep learning
systems in industry — signal processing at Thales, drug discovery at Iktos, foundation
models for biology at MBZUAI and GenBio AI.
